meta.title: Lumemon · Your next legend
meta.description: Discover Lumemon: a Pokémon card collection and turn-based battle project.

universe.title:
Collect the thrill.
Build your story.
universe.intro: Three ways to live one adventure. This is the game we're building.
universe.packsText: Earn coins in battle, open packs and find the card that transforms your collection. Duplicates count too: turn them into fragments.
universe.teamText: Build your team, discover more powerful variants and combine types and support cards to make it your own.
universe.battleText: Learn against the computer, then challenge friends in private rooms. Turns, status effects and decisions that matter.

practice.title: Your next move.
practice.description: Six cards. One strategy. Step into the arena, get to know your team and test each decision against the bot.
practice.localNotice: Local practice · No timer or rewards. Reloading or leaving this page discards the match.
practice.howTo: Before you enter: how it works
practice.rule1: Choose a move or switch to a reserve, then confirm your turn. Switches happen first; the faster Pokémon then attacks first. Speed ties use a random draw.
practice.rule2: Types can multiply or prevent damage. Powerful and status moves have cooldowns; status moves deal no direct damage.
practice.rule3: When your Pokémon faints, choose a living reserve to continue. Win by knocking out all six opponents. The match draws at the end of turn 60 if nobody has won.
practice.adapted: Lumemon uses its own rules and stats. Printed card text and values belong to the TCG and are not used in this practice. Support cards are not enabled yet.

practice.replaceHint: Choose a living reserve below. This replacement does not use another turn.
practice.botLocked: The bot has already chosen its action. Take your time; both actions resolve when you confirm.
practice.switchHint: Switching uses your action. The incoming card receives the rival attack. Sleep or freeze blocks the next move attempt, then clears.

motion.ready: Arena ready · choose your next action

tutorial.label: First steps
tutorial.entryBody: Learn by playing with a prepared team: attack, read types, switch Pokémon and apply a status. Your team selection is kept. The tutorial always uses the Versatile opponent.
tutorial.observingHint: Switches happen first, then moves in speed order. Watch the cards and their health. The next lesson appears when playback ends.
tutorial.completeNote: You finished the guide, not the match. Keep practising with this team. No rewards or account progress.

welcome.title: Six cards. One active Pokémon.
welcome.body: Your active Pokémon is on the left and your opponent is on the right. HP shows their remaining health; your other five cards wait in reserve. Take your time: this practice has no timer.

attack.title: Your first attack
attack.body: Let's use Thunderbolt with Pikachu. Select an action, then confirm it. The bot has already chosen its action; speed determines who attacks first. Thunderbolt has a one-turn cooldown.
attack.action: Select Thunderbolt below and press Confirm turn.

types.title: Type matters
types.body: Thunderbolt had ×1 effectiveness against Abra: neutral damage. ×2 increases damage, ×0.5 reduces it and ×0 means immunity. The move type is compared with every type the opponent has. Thunderbolt will be available again on turn 3.

switch.title: Protect your Pokémon
switch.body: Pikachu has taken damage. Switch to Jigglypuff to spread it across your team. Switching uses your action and happens before attacks: the incoming Pokémon takes the opponent's hit.
switch.action: Choose Jigglypuff in your reserves and confirm the turn.

status.title: A status is a play, too
status.body: Jigglypuff can use Sing to put Abra to sleep. In Lumemon's rules, sleep blocks the next attempted move, then clears. Your opponent can still act before falling asleep.
status.action: Select Sing and confirm the turn. Check the opponent's status.

complete.title: You know the essentials
complete.body: You attacked, read types, switched Pokémon and applied sleep. Abra is asleep: its next attempted move will be blocked. Keep battling to see it and try your own decisions.

opponents.title: Choose your opponent
opponents.hint: Difficulty varies with cards, supports and strategy. Elite also looks for defensive switches. The bot decides before your choice and follows the same effects and usage limits.

rookie.name: Rookie
rookie.description: Six common cards to practise familiar types. Eevee leads the team.

balanced.name: Versatile
balanced.description: The classic opponent: five common cards and an uncommon Lapras. Abra leads a team with varied types.

elite.name: Elite
elite.description: Three special illustration rares and three rare cards. Charizard starts; Elite may find a safer reserve and waits two turns before retreating again.

supports.title: Support cards
supports.rules: Choose zero to three. Each card works once per battle on your active Pokémon and takes your entire turn. Barrier and Boost are removed when switching out or fainting.
supports.scope: Opponents use supports too: inspect their cards before entering and track their uses in the arena. Lumemon effects are adaptations of the TCG. Both teams start the tutorial without supports.
supports.turnCost: One use only. Replaces your attack this turn.

descriptions.heal: Restores 30% of maximum HP without exceeding the maximum.
descriptions.cleanse: Removes the current status. Usable while asleep or frozen too.
descriptions.barrier: Reduces attack damage by 30% this turn and next. Does not reduce poison or burn damage.
descriptions.boost: Two damaging attacks at ×1.5. Expires at the end of the second turn after use.

supports.opponentNone: This opponent has no supports in this match.

battleSummary.comparison: Team comparison at the end of the battle
battleSummary.note: Only HP actually lost or restored is counted. Poison and burn damage appears under the team receiving it. Fainted Pokémon belong to the team in each column.
